overview.purpose: Document the supplied SampleHold_Update synthetic API/state fixture.
overview.scope: Fixture only. This is not a business API, approved RTOS interface or DLL ABI.
overview.source_requirement: Validate pointers, read one sample through Project_ReadSample, commit state/output on API success and preserve them on failure.
overview.source_locator: Supplied routine-code-c90 assets/examples/sample-hold/spec.json, Project_Sample.h, Project_TestMock.h and mock_project_sample.c.
overview.coverage: Covers the supplied synthetic function, state and supplied immediate API contract. External API synchronization and real device/RTOS behavior are outside the fixture.

trial_assumptions.text: FIXTURE ONLY. Supplied header/mock model a bounded immediate call: returns 0 and writes an arbitrary representable int on success; nonzero on failure, with output unspecified. Call exactly once after pointer validation. No allocation, blocking, lock, or real device access is modeled.
Independent states may be used by independent callers; external API synchronization is outside this fixture.

interface.visibility: Synthetic ordinary C function; no real DLL ABI is defined.

parameters.name: state
parameters.contract: Caller-owned, valid writable nonoverlapping storage. Initial last_sample=0 and has_sample=0.

parameters.name: out_sample
parameters.contract: Caller-owned writable int, disjoint from state.

return_codes.meaning: Read succeeded and both outputs updated.
A pointer was null; no API call or writes.
Synthetic API failed; preserve state and output.

interface.preconditions: Each nonnull pointer refers to caller-owned valid writable storage, with state and out_sample disjoint. Initial state is last_sample=0 and has_sample=0. Null pointers are rejected before the API call. No validity check for nonnull addresses is specified.

configuration.name: external_api

value.name: Project_ReadSample
value.contract: FIXTURE ONLY. Supplied header/mock model a bounded immediate call: returns 0 and writes an arbitrary representable int on success; nonzero on failure, with output unspecified. Call exactly once after pointer validation. No allocation, blocking, lock, or real device access is modeled.

configuration.meaning: Supplied synthetic API. Include Project_Sample.h; call once after pointer validation with a local temporary.

configuration.name: test_mock_controls
configuration.meaning: Supplied fixture harness controls only; never include this test header in the implementation. The supplied mock writes the temporary result even on API failure.

state_fields.name: state.last_sample
state_fields.meaning: Sample from the latest successful call. Preserve on pointer/API failure.

state_fields.name: state.has_sample
state_fields.range: Initial 0; success sets 1. No validation of prior values is specified.
state_fields.meaning: Indicates that a successful sample was committed. Preserve on pointer/API failure.

result_fields.name: *out_sample
result_fields.meaning: Read sample on success; unchanged on pointer/API failure.

steps.text: If either pointer is null, return -1 without API calls or writes.
Call the supplied API once using a local temporary sample.
On nonzero API status, return -2 without writing state or out_sample.
On API success, set state.last_sample to the sample, state.has_sample to 1, and out_sample to the sample; return 0.

behavior.postconditions: API success commits all three values. Pointer/API failure preserves state and output. No shared static function state is used.
behavior.timing_semantics: The supplied API models a bounded immediate fixture call. No measured WCET, blocking/locking behavior or real RTOS/device access is certified.

constraints.text: Include only supplied contracts; do not invent a real RTOS API or DLL ABI.
Use no shared static state, loops, recursion, dynamic memory, or direct operating-system APIs.

verification_examples.input: Supplied mock: api_status=0, api_sample=23; valid disjoint pointers.
verification_examples.expected: return=0; state.last_sample=23; state.has_sample=1; *out_sample=23; exactly one API call.

verification_examples.input: Supplied mock: api_status=7, api_sample=-99; valid disjoint pointers.
verification_examples.expected: return=-2; state and *out_sample unchanged; exactly one API call even though the mock writes its local result.
